question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Envoy
solution:
The correct answer is: **'****Ambassador**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"envoy"** refers to a representative or messenger, especially one on a diplomatic mission. (दूत)

 
 
• **Example: **The president sent an **envoy **to negotiate peace with the neighboring country.
 
 
 
• **"Ambassador"** is a synonym for envoy and refers to an official representative sent by a country to represent it in a foreign country. (राजदूत)
 
 
• **Example: **The **ambassador **attended the international conference to discuss trade relations.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Carrier** (वाहक): A person or thing that carries, holds, or conveys something.

 
 
• **Example: **The mail **carrier **delivers letters and packages to our homes.
 
 
 
• **Chief** (मुख्य): A leader or ruler of a people or clan.
 
 
• **Example: **The **chief **of the tribe made an important announcement.
 
 
 
• **Receiver** (प्राप्तकर्ता): A person who gets or accepts something that has been sent or given to them.
 
 
• **Example: **The **receiver **of the award gave an emotional speech.
